description: This file defines a PHP class TCPDFBarcode that generates array representations for various 1D barcode types used with TCPDF, including CODE 39, CODE 93, Code 128, EAN, UPC, MSI, POSTNET, and others. It includes methods for encoding, checksum calculations, and converting barcode sequences into array formats suitable for rendering.

classes.name: TCPDFBarcode
classes.description: A class for creating array representations of various 1D barcodes for use with TCPDF.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the barcode object with a code and type, generating the barcode array.

methods.name: getBarcodeArray
methods.description: Returns the generated barcode array representation.

methods.name: setBarcode
methods.description: Sets the barcode data based on code and type, calling specific encoding methods.

methods.name: barcode_code39
methods.description: Generates a CODE 39 barcode sequence as an array.

methods.name: encode_code39_ext
methods.description: Encodes a string for CODE 39 extended mode.

methods.name: checksum_code39
methods.description: Calculates checksum for CODE 39.

methods.name: barcode_code93
methods.description: Generates a CODE 93 barcode sequence.

methods.name: checksum_code93
methods.description: Calculates checksum for CODE 93.

methods.name: barcode_s25
methods.description: Generates Standard 2 of 5 barcode sequence.

methods.name: barcode_i25
methods.description: Generates Interleaved 2 of 5 barcode sequence.

methods.name: barcode_c128
methods.description: Generates Code 128 barcode sequence.

methods.name: barcode_eanupc
methods.description: Generates EAN or UPC barcode sequence.

methods.name: barcode_eanext
methods.description: Generates EAN extension barcode sequence.

methods.name: barcode_postnet
methods.description: Generates POSTNET or PLANET barcode sequence.

methods.name: barcode_imb
methods.description: Generates Intelligent Mail Barcode sequence (requires bcmath extension).

methods.name: dec_to_hex
methods.description: Converts a large decimal number to hexadecimal string (requires bcmath).

methods.name: hex_to_dec
methods.description: Converts a large hexadecimal string to decimal (requires bcmath).

methods.name: imb_crc11fcs
methods.description: Calculates the Frame Check Sequence for IMB.

methods.name: imb_reverse_us
methods.description: Reverses bits of a 16-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: imb_tables
methods.description: Generates lookup tables for IMB encoding.
